name: Abyssal Body
body:
School abjuration (evil); Level antipaladin 2, cleric 3, inquisitor 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target 1 evil creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You touch a creature and its body is instantly infused with infernal defenses.

The target creature gains DR 5/good.
